source: Frozen TTF independent climate crossfit artifact of run 36270581743: unit_climate_crossfit.csv; climate features identical for each WGSRPD3 across butterfly rows

preprocessing.bio12: natural log1p before z-standardization, to limit heavy-tailed annual precipitation
preprocessing.standardization_pool: all unique WGSRPD3 with complete non-sentinel values (not outcome filtered)
preprocessing.missing: exclude regions with missing climate data or BIO12 >= 65535 (suspected saturation/sentinel)
preprocessing.distance: unweighted Euclidean distance in four z-scaled bioclimatic dimensions

pairs.background: WGSRPD3 regions with native butterfly resource presence
pairs.analog: lowest quartile of standardized climate distance among eligible far cross-Level1 pairs
pairs.discordant: highest quartile of the same pool
pairs.cutoffs: fixed by climate inputs alone, never by resource similarity outcomes

primary: mean contemporary-minus-native butterfly resource Jaccard gain among climate analogue distant cross-Level1 pairs minus the same gain for climatically dissimilar distant cross-Level1 pairs

null.method: same Level1 restricted butterfly × region fixed margin edge swaps as v0.1
preserves: introduced added regions by butterfly x Level1
introduced butterfly opportunity count by region

pass: primary contrast > null median and one-sided Monte Carlo p<=0.05; pre-specified ecological validation of the earlier latitude proxy
fail: do not call latitude result climate driven; do not select alternative climate variables or cutoffs after outcomes
limits: regional climate summaries median of grid sample points; not microclimatic niches
regional pair observations are dependent but permutations operate on incidence edges
plant-only floristic benchmark needed to claim consumer-specific amplification
no realized butterfly occupancy or host use tested
scope: analysis branch only; main GEB manuscript unchanged
